title: Analista De Inteligência De Negócios
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Analista De Inteligência De Negócios em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

Quais são os desafios da área e do cargo:Esta pessoa terá como objetivo atuar de forma alinhada à visão estratégica de Negócios do Grupo Fleury, contribuindo para a construção de um ecossistema de Saúde integrado, preventivo e híbrido, tendo como principal foco o cuidado com as pessoas.Se você tem interesse em fazer parte desse propósito e deseja estar sempre um passo a frente do mercado, vem com a gente!Sobre a área:Responsável por avaliar o desempenho do negócio, incluindo seus serviços e unidades realizando estudos, avaliações e análises do negócio que resultam na geração de valor financeiro ou não no Grupo FleuryPrincipais atividades:Acelerar as implantações das sinergias de negóciosAuxiliar gestores da marca no modelo de gestão adotado atualmente no grupoSuporte à marca na implementação e condução de rituais de gestão para auxiliar os negócios na tomada de decisão, tendo como algumas das entregas:Fóruns quinzenais/mensais de negóciosForecast e estimativas (previsões de receita, volume e margem)Acompanhamento de ações táticas (PMO)Elaboração do Planejamento estratégico e orçamentoAnálises de diagnóstico e elaboração de planos de açãoAvaliação e implementação de oportunidades (benchmark com demais marcas do grupo e identificação)Construção de relatórios e indicadores de desempenhoConstrução de Estudos de ViabilidadeAtender as demandas dos gestores de negócios realizando estudos de grande complexidade e planos para correção dos desvios; Construir planos para o cumprimento do orçamento de receita e margem, apoiando as unidades de negócios; Avaliar e recomendar alterações de mix de serviços e unidades; Auxiliar na definição de oferta de serviços nas unidades e identificar oportunidades de expansão ou redução da oferta assegurando o alcance das metas financeiras acordadas; Entregar resultado financeiro dos negócios e da companhia; Contribuir paraa otimização dos resultados internos por meio da análise de indicadores e relatórios Financeiros e operacionais, identificando oportunidades de melhoria e recomendando mudanças nos procedimentos da área; Atuar com o desenvolvimento e execução de projetos que refletem diretamente na satisfação e fidelização dos clientes; Buscamos alguém que apresente:Formação: Ensino Superior CompletoInformática: SAP, Pacote OfficeConhecimento avançado de Finanças (análise de DRE, construção de estudos de viabilidade); Conhecimento avançado na manipulação de base de dados e na ferramenta excel; Diferenciais:Conhecimentos específicos em visualização de dados para Analytics, Inteligência Artificial e Aprendizado de Máquina são diferenciais; Antes da inscrição na vaga, é importante verificar se você atende aos requisitos e se conecta com nosso propósito.Nossa essência inspira o dia a dia, por isso, buscamos pessoas apaixonadas pelo que fazem, e que:-  Estimulem um ambiente de troca de conhecimentos, compartilhando experiências, possibilitando a interdependência entre os times; -  Estejam em constante movimento, investindo em autodesenvolvimento e atuando como facilitadora no desenvolvimento das outras pessoas; -  Busquem consciência social de diversidade e inclusão, cooperando com a construção de um ambiente colaborativo; -  Identifiquem e antecipem as necessidades dos clientes, agindo prontamente para encontrar soluções adequadas e personalizadas; -  Planejem e executem o trabalho com excelência a fim de atingir os resultados esperados, com a visão de inovação e agilidade; -  Gerem e implementem novas ideias, buscando constantemente por melhorias para a experimentação de novas abordagens e a adaptação às mudanças do mercado.Informações da vaga:Modelo de Trabalho (100% Presencial - Região Campinas, com disponibilidade para viagens a cada 15 dias)Carga Horária: 220hEscala: Segunda á sextaHorário de Trabalho: 08h00 ás 17h48Cuidamos de você em cada etapa da sua jornada!Saúde e Bem-estar:-  Assistência médica e odontológica para você e sua família; -  Ambulatório comclínica médica ou atendimento por telemedicina; Proteção e estabilidade:-  Seguro de vida.Facilidades para o dia a dia:-  Vale-Transporte; Aqui, o cuidado vai além dos benefícios — ele está presente em cada momento da sua trajetória.Promovemos uma cultura inclusiva, focada na equidade e na valorização das diferenças. Nossas vagas são abertas para todos os públicos e, simbolizando a nossa intencionalidade, oferecemos oportunidades afirmativas.Nosso compromisso vai além do cumprimento das legislações que incentivam a diversidade e inclusão. Trabalhamos ativamente para ampliar a representatividade de nossas pessoas, pensando em raça, etnia, gênero, gerações, pessoas com deficiência e LGBTQIAPN+ em nosso time, além de fortalecer a representatividade de mulheres negras, indígenas, chefes de família.Para conhecer mais sobre o Grupo Fleury, acesse o site:  Grupo Fleury informa que a participação em seus processos seletivos é gratuita e nenhuma empresa terceira está autorizada a cobrar valores para a candidatura às vagas, ao treinamento, ao material didático ou qualquer outra despesa relacionada

description:
Confira a oportunidade para Liquidity Partnership Manager (LATAM) em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

Role Overview  We are looking for an LP Partnership Manager to drive business development and build strong relationships with liquidity providers across key regions. This role will be instrumental in sourcing, onboarding, and managing LP partners, while working closely with the trading team to optimize liquidity, pricing, and execution. The ideal candidate is highly connected within the local market, with a strong network of liquidity providers and a deep understanding of regional payment and banking landscapes. Key Responsibilities  Business Development & Partnerships  Identify, source, and establish relationships with local and regional liquidity providers Evaluate LP quality (pricing, depth, reliability, regions covered) Negotiate trading terms (spreads, fees, credit lines, margin terms)  Market & Network Development  Leverage existing network to expand LP coverage in key regions (APAC, LATAM, Africa) Maintain strong relationships with banks, payment providers, and liquidity partners Stay up to date with local market dynamics, pricing trends, and competitive landscape  Execution & Collaboration  Work closely with traders to ensure optimal liquidity, pricing, and execution quality Coordinate with internal teams to onboard LPs and ensure smooth operational setup Support ongoing performance monitoring and optimization of LP relationships  Banking & Infrastructure Setup  Facilitate opening of bank accounts and payment rails required for LP operations Identify suitable partners to support local currency flows and settlement  Requirements  5 to 10 years of experience in business development, partnerships, or liquidity management Strong experience in payments, FX, trading, or related financial services Well connected with liquidity providers, banks, and payment partners Proven ability to source and onboard LPs in local markets Strong understanding of regional market structures and liquidity dynamics Must have strong, deep LP network in at least one of the following regions: LATAM   Vision & Mission  OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors. OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

About Turing:  Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems. Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies. Role Overview:  We are looking for candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in the content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles! Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world! What does day-to-day look like:  You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn: Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?) In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.  Requirements:  Multilingual capabilities are mandatory. (English and German)  Analytical Skills : Good research and analytical skills Feedback Skills : Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations. Creative Thinking : Creative and lateral thinking abilities. Communication : Excellent communication and collaboration skills. Independence : Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting. Commitment : Ability to commit to 40 hours per week for the contract duration overlapping US hours. Technical Setup : Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.  Preferred Qualifications:  Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area. Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.) Understanding of Excel and Google Suite. Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is highly desirable.  Perks of Freelancing With Turing:  Work in a fully remote environment. Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies. Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.  Offer Details:  Engagement type :  Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave) Commitments Required :  Availability of up to 40 hours/week is preferred. This is a fully remote position based in Brazil. You will be engaged as an independent contractor. Salary: USD $900/month plus performance-based quarterly bonus of up to $400. Includes paid time off, parental leave, and health insurance. Company Overview  Jones is a vertical AI company that helps real estate and construction firms make smarter decisions about insurance so they can boost efficiency and mitigate risk. Across more than 2.5 billion square feet of real estate and construction projects, Jones enables clients to leverage AI, software, and data to accelerate and strengthen insurance verification, collection, integration, and decision-making across commercial and residential asset classes. Jones has experienced rapid growth driven by the urgent need to modernize the outdated risk and compliance workflows in real estate and construction. In this position, you’ll be sitting at the heart of our operations team and play a direct role in delivering on our core product promise. As the key part of your responsibilities, you'll review certificates submitted by tenants, vendors, and subcontractors, confirm that required coverages are in place, and flag gaps before they become problems for our customers. Success here demands precision, a methodical approach, and the ability to stay consistent under volume. If that sounds like you, we'd love to connect. Please note that this is a dedicated, full-time position requiring your undivided professional focus; it is not compatible with concurrent employment or part-time arrangements. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds. We use focused assessments to evaluate fit. If you're detail-oriented and eager to grow, we encourage you to apply. What You’ll Do  Review Certificates of Insurance (COIs) and supporting documents, verifying that coverage meets each client's specific requirements; Accurately input compliance data into our system and flag any gaps or missing coverage for resolution; Follow internal processes and guidelines to ensure best practices are upheld; Collaborate actively with the team to support shared goals and maintain workflow continuity.  Who You Are  A clear, professional communicator in English, with strong written and verbal skills for cross-team collaboration. Available 40 hours per week during U.S. business hours (EST). Consistently accurate, with a track record of meeting quality targets. Coachable and growth-minded: you respond well to feedback, document your learnings, and apply improvements quickly. Comfortable following structured workflows and confident enough to escalate when something doesn't add up. Self-motivated and persistent: you work well independently without needing close oversight. Background in insurance, data entry, quality assurance, or any structured, process-driven role is a plus.  Why Join Jones  Become an expert in an area of real estate/construction operations and insurance that is undergoing serious digital transformation Join an award-winning company tracking best-in-class SaaS growth month-over-month. Fair compensation with performance-based raises and bonuses; Learn directly from talented, experienced leaders who are invested in your growth. Gain hands-on experience in a dynamic, multicultural startup environment. Be part of a lean, agile team with a strong culture and a big vision. Help Jones execute on a massive vision to build a network for risk & compliance transactions in the built world Develop a strong understanding of SaaS operations fundamentals and skills needed to grow in a start-up company.  Our culture  Our goal is to build a company where people feel ownership of their role and are able to grow and enrich their skills and experience. We also want to create an environment where people are challenged and encouraged to be entrepreneurial. We rely on our team to help identify and take action on initiatives that can move our business forward. Elements of our culture that can be seen in every one of our people are the following: Fall in love with problems –  We are obsessed with solving customer problems because it’s in our DNA — actively listening to customer challenges and treating them like our own. Give help generously –  We hire and nurture brilliant people who are generous with their time, skills, and perspectives. This generosity compounds across the company. Own the outcome –  Every day we make vital decisions that shape the future of our company. We hold ourselves accountable to these decisions in order to build a durable, powerful business. Take care of yourself –  Building a category-leading company is hard. It can only be achieved by encouraging and enabling our team’s mental, emotional, and physical well-being. Build trust everywhere –  Every Jones experience is designed to give our clients, our team, and our industry unshakable confidence in the integrity of the company.

and pacing without being told exactly what to do Implementing caption systems with color-coded text (white/red/blue pill captions, green keyword highlights, auto-generated TikTok-style captions) depending on the ad format Cutting multiple versions of the same ad (hook variants, length variants, aspect ratio variants) for A/B testing Maintaining a fast turnaround — most ads should go from brief to finished export within 2-4 hours Organizing and managing a growing library of raw assets, finished ads, and creative templates  What You Need  Proven experience editing direct response or reference ad pacing intuitively — if we send you a competitor ad, you can deconstruct its cut timing, caption rhythm, and visual structure without being taught Comfort working with AI-generated imagery and integrating it seamlessly into live footage and product photography Experience with caption styling — you've built caption systems before (color-coded, keyword-highlighted, timed to VO) and you understand that captions are a conversion tool, not an accessibility afterthought A sharp eye for thumbnail-level scroll-stopping — you understand that the first frame of a video ad is a static image in the feed and you treat it accordingly Ability to self-manage, meet daily output targets, and communicate proactively when something is unclear or delayed Reliable internet connection and availability during US business hours (ET or CT preferred but flexible for the right person)  Bonus (Not Required)  Experience editing ads in the health, wellness, fitness, or DTC supplement space Familiarity with the \"ugly ad\" aesthetic — ads intentionally designed to look like organic UGC rather than polished production Experience with motion graphics or basic After Effects animation (for text overlays, simple transitions, or kinetic typography) Understanding of direct response copywriting principles (you know why a hook matters, why the product should appear early, why the CTA needs to sound like a peer recommendation)  What You Don't Need  A film degree A fancy reel of cinematic work Experience at a big agency Color grading expertise  We care about speed, instinct, and output quality at volume. If your best work is a single beautifully-graded 3-minute brand film, this isn't the right fit. If your best work is 47 Meta ads you cut last month that all drove profitable ROAS, we want to talk to you. Compensation  Competitive rate based on experience. This is a contract role with potential to grow into a long-term position as the brand scales. We value speed and consistency — editors who hit daily output targets reliably will have no shortage of work. How To Apply  There will be a paid test before any hire is made. Here's how it works: Apply with your portfolio.  Send 3-5 examples of direct response video ads you've edited that actually ran on Meta or TikTok. Tell us the niche, the objective, and the result if you have it. We don't need a sizzle reel — we need proof you've done this before. If your portfolio fits, we'll send you a paid test project.  You'll receive a reference ad, a script, raw assets (footage, images, voiceover), and a creative brief. You'll have 24 hours to deliver a finished ad. This test is paid regardless of whether you're hired.  We evaluate the test on four criteria:  Did you match the pacing and structure of the reference? Did the first frame stop the scroll? Did the captions and visual rhythm support the VO? Did you deliver on time?  If the test passes, you start with a one-week trial  at 1 ad per day. If that week goes well, we scale to full output.  We're not looking for perfection. We're looking for someone who ships fast, learns from references quickly, and gets better with every ad they cut. To apply, send your portfolio and a brief note about your direct response editing experience to (your email) with the subject line \"DR Editor — (Your Name).\"

Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento. Também deverá fornecer visibilidade e relatórios em nível executivo, assegurando transparência sobre o andamento do programa. Também deverá validar a alocação de recursos em conjunto com o Delivery Manager. title: ServiceNow Application Portfolio Management (APM) & Data Quality Engineer - Contractor in USD
description:
Nova vaga disponível para ServiceNow Application Portfolio Management (APM) & Data Quality Engineer - Contractor in USD em campinas. Saiba mais sobre essa oportunidade.

For our international customer in Valencia, we are looking for a ServiceNow Application Portfolio Management (APM) & Data Quality Engineer. The role focuses on ongoing APM data maintenance in ServiceNow (APM/CMDB-related records as applicable), identifying data gaps and inconsistencies, coordinating updates with application/service owners, and tracking technical debt indicators and remediation progress.  EU candidates are welcome to apply. Candidates need to be based in Valencia or willing to relocate to Valencia. Candidates need to be flexible to work across time zones, including alignment with US Eastern Time where required. Work permit is not provided. Candidates need to be fluent in English. Tasks and responsibilities:  Perform ongoing maintenance of Application Portfolio Management (APM) data within ServiceNow, including application inventory, ownership, lifecycle status, technology attributes, and documented integrations/dependencies, ensuring data accuracy, completeness, and currency; Identify and remediate data quality issues such as missing or invalid values, duplicate records, and inconsistent classifications through coordination with application owners, service owners, and relevant stakeholders; Maintain and enhance portfolio data governance standards and controlled vocabularies, including lifecycle states, business and technical fit assessments, and application criticality classifications; Monitor and track technical debt indicators leveraging ServiceNow portfolio data, including lifecycle and obsolescence risks, unsupported technologies, architectural non-conformities, and resilience or operability gaps; Maintain a centralized log or aligned ServiceNow records documenting technical debt items, including impacted applications/services, severity and priority ratings, and recommended remediation actions such as retirement, replacement, or modernization; Develop and deliver recurring dashboards, reports, and portfolio insights for the onsite Enterprise Architect, including technical debt trends, aging remediation items, progress tracking, and portfolio risk hotspots; Translate stakeholder inputs, priorities, and publishing schedules into updates for the APM website and related communication materials; Maintain and support the APM website as a central platform for publishing portfolio data, standards, insights, lifecycle guidance, and reference information related to Application Portfolio Management practices;  Profile:  Master’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline; +8 years of overall experience in Information Technology; +3 years of experience supporting Enterprise Architects or working within Enterprise Architecture teams; Hands-on experience with ServiceNow, specifically supporting Application Portfolio Management (APM) data, including application and CMDB records, data validation, monitoring, maintenance, and reporting; Strong understanding of Application Portfolio Management (APM) principles, including application inventory management, lifecycle governance, business and technical fit assessments, risk and obsolescence analysis, and application rationalization strategies (retire, replace, modernize); Proven experience identifying, documenting, and tracking technical debt, including the definition of debt indicators, maintenance of remediation records, and generation of actionable reporting and insights; Solid understanding of Enterprise Architecture concepts and practices, including architecture principles, standards, governance, target-state architecture, roadmaps, and architecture deliverables, as well as the role of portfolio data in strategic decision-making; Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with distributed stakeholders to resolve data quality issues and drive timely completion of application and portfolio record updates; Previous experience delivering similar ServiceNow APM and technical debt management activities within large or complex enterprise environments is highly preferred; Strong analytical, reporting, and problem-solving capabilities, including experience producing dashboards, scorecards, KPI reporting, and trend analysis with a strong focus on data integrity and attention to detail; AI literacy, including practical experience using AI and Generative AI tools to enhance productivity in areas such as data analysis, reporting, documentation, and knowledge management, within approved enterprise governance frameworks; Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to document processes, prepare executive-ready materials, and communicate findings effectively to Enterprise Architects and business stakeholders; Working knowledge of Enterprise Architecture frameworks and methodologies such as TOGAF and their practical application in enterprise architecture deliverables and governance processes; Working knowledge of ServiceNow data model fundamentals relevant to Application Portfolio Management, including CMDB structures, application records, CSDM concepts, and portfolio data governance practices; Relevant certifications are considered an advantage, including:  TOGAF or equivalent Enterprise Architecture certification; ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA); ServiceNow Certified Application Developer (CAD) and/or relevant ServiceNow implementation certifications related to APM or CMDB; Experience with enterprise architecture and portfolio management tooling, including ServiceNow EA Workspace and APM reporting capabilities, is considered a plus; Familiarity with responsible AI principles and the secure use of enterprise AI assistants, including prompt hygiene and protection of sensitive information, is considered an advantage; Fluent in English;

description:

As an Accounting Analyst, you’ll join our passionate and supportive team characterised by our ambition and team spirit. You’ll have the freedom to work independently while fostering strong collaboration with our finance and operations departments. You’ll be responsible for ensuring the accuracy and compliance of our financial records, preparing key financial statements, and supporting the business with timely and data-driven reporting. This role requires a proactive approach, a strong grasp of Brazilian tax regulations, and the ability to work autonomously in a fast-paced remote environment. Specifically, your role will involve:  Maintain accurate financial records and ensure compliance with Brazilian tax laws (SPED, ICMS, PIS, COFINS, ISS, etc.). Prepare and analyze financial statements (DRE, Balanço Patrimonial, Fluxo de Caixa). Oversee accounts payable and receivable, payroll, and bank reconciliations. Maintain internal financial controls and accounting procedures. Prepare and analyze the company’s accountant closing to ensure accuracy and transparency. Develop accounting reports to support decision-making.  The ideal profile    We're on the lookout for someone who not only shares our values and ambitions but also envisions growing alongside MoveUp Media. As a dedicated team player, you embody fair play, transparency, agility, and an unstoppable drive. You're the perfect fit for our team if you: Have outstanding written and verbal communication skills in Portuguese and English. Understand Brazilian tax regulations, including the new tax reform (IBS, CBS), and international accounting standards (IFRS). Demonstrate strong knowledge of accounting principles, daily journal entries, and monthly, quarterly, and annual closings. Have a minimum of 3–5 years of experience as Analista Contábil. Hold a Bachelor’s degree in Accounting. Are proficient in accounting software — knowledge of Odoo is a plus. Excel in advanced Excel skills and familiarity with financial analysis tools. Be ambitious, adaptable, and thrive in fast-paced environments. Focus on accuracy, compliance, and delivering reliable financial information. Show active listening, resilience, and persistence. Demonstrate strong problem-solving abilities and effective task coordination. Excel in time management, organization, and planning. Manage multiple accounts and tasks simultaneously. Use analytical skills and a data-driven mindset for decision-making. Thrive in teamwork and adapt well to evolving environments.   Feeling up to the task of managing the main challenges of the role, even without meeting all criteria? We're eager to hear from you! We know not all great candidates will match 100% of the above.  Next steps in the process ✅  First Interview:  A conversation with your future manager to ensure you meet the role’s requirements. Second Interview:  A chat with HR to understand you better and ensure a cultural fit with MoveUp Media. Third Interview:  A conversation with our CFO to align on technical expectations and ensure you're the right fit for our finance team. Final Step:  A proposition for us to start working together!  What’s in it for you  Remote Work Environment:  Enjoy the flexibility of working remotely full-time. Flexible Schedule:  We measure results , not hours, and offer paid time off. Development Opportunities:  As a rapidly growing startup, we offer numerous possibilities for career advancement and support your career path. Team Gatherings:  Annual team get-togethers to connect, work, and have fun  . We strive to find enjoyable spots for everyone. Wellness Fund:  €1,000 per year dedicated to your professional development, sports, or cultural events of your choice.  MoveUp Media
